The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Nathema's northern continent''' was the site of at least one [[Tenebrae's village|farming village]]. The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Tenebrae]], the son of Medriaas's ruling [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath]], conquered the northern continent during his rise to power.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
